description: Source code for the Daltonizer class implementing color blindness simulation and correction algorithms in Android's graphics system.

classes.name: Daltonizer
classes.description: Class responsible for simulating and correcting color blindness effects using color transformation matrices.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of color blindness to simulate or correct.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the mode to either simulation or correction.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Returns the current color transformation matrix, updating it if necessary.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Calculates the color transformation matrix based on current type and mode.
